zone.sentenceEn: So does the essential ability to keep your emotional tone in the calm zone .
zone.translationZh: 保持情绪基调处于平静状态的核心能力亦是如此。
zone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

zone.sentenceEn: Today, London has effectively reduced traffic emissions through the introduction of a Congestion Charge Zone in 2003, and an Ultra Low Emission Zone in 2019.
zone.translationZh: 如今，伦敦通过2003年引入的拥堵收费区和2019年实施的超低排放区，有效减少了交通排放。

zone.sentenceEn: He will line up Monday in Antarctica(南极) for the first leg of the World Marathon Challenge—joining 32 other adventure seekers on an unusual journey where participants travel through different time zones and climates to run seven marathons on seven continents in seven days.
zone.translationZh: 周一，他将在南极站到起跑线前，参加世界马拉松挑战赛的第一站比赛——与其他32名探险爱好者一同踏上这段非凡旅程。参赛者将穿越不同时区和气候带，在七天内于七大洲完成七场马拉松。

zone.sentenceEn: Sleeping on a crammed plane, adjusting to different time zones and finding food to eat (Wardian is a vegetarian) would make it an exhausting trip over a month, let alone a week.
zone.translationZh: 在拥挤的飞机上睡觉、调整时差、寻找食物（沃迪安是素食者）——即便行程长达一个月，这些事情也足以让人疲惫不堪，更不用说只有一周时间了。

zone.sentenceEn: But in this deposit, the bones occur throughout a zone of sandstone about 12 feet thick.
zone.translationZh: 但在这个矿床中，骨骼分布在整个约12英尺厚的砂岩带中。
zone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

zone.sentenceEn: People in their comfort zone of temperature are more satisfied with their productivity.
zone.translationZh: 处于温度舒适区的人们对自己的工作效率更为满意。
